name: graphcraft-memory
description: Knowledge-graph memory for Claude Code: facts from every session are linked into one graph per machine, and the relevant part is handed to Claude before each prompt. Other mods (like zonecraft) can feed it.

capture.title: Learn from conversations
capture.description: Save each conversation and turn it into facts: as it goes (see the next setting), when it compacts, and at the next session start for the rest. Off: recall only.

extractModel.title: Extraction model
extractModel.description: The model that reads saved conversations. haiku: cheap and fast. sonnet: catches subtler facts, costs more.

captureEvery.title: Learn during the conversation
captureEvery.description: Also read the conversation after every this many of your messages, so what is settled now is recalled in this session too (one small model call each time). 0: only when it ends or compacts.

recallFacts.title: Facts per prompt
recallFacts.description: How many remembered facts Claude gets with each message (1 to 40). More gives fuller context and uses more of the context window.

recallDepth.title: How far recall reaches
recallDepth.description: How many links out from what your message names (1 to 3). 1: only facts about the things you named. 3: their wider surroundings too.

otherProjects.title: Recall from other projects
otherProjects.description: Let facts learned in other projects come up, ranked after this project's. Off: only this project's facts and global ones.

skipTypes.title: Kinds of things not to remember
skipTypes.description: Comma-separated types that are neither learned nor recalled, e.g. PERSON, PREFERENCE. Types: PERSON, PROJECT, TOOL, FILE, CONCEPT, DECISION, PROBLEM, PREFERENCE (plus any your mods add). Facts already saved stay in the graph, hidden from recall.

warmRecall.title: Keep recall warm
warmRecall.description: Keep one small Python process running for the session so recall takes about 5 ms instead of about 150 ms. Off: Python starts fresh for each message.

mapLayout.title: Map opens in
mapLayout.description: The layout /graph-view opens with. Structured: a column per kind, rows grouped by project. Free: a force-directed web.
